title: Channels of the deployment (channels.yaml) v0.3.0
description: Per actor, under the id of its cell, and per channel that the actor's policy declares: the technique of the channel (RFC-047). Which channels there are, who logs in through them and what they supply is policy; this file only says how the login looks.

additionalProperties.description: The channels of one actor, by the id the policy gives them.

adapter.description: The technique of the login. Only a simulated login: no register and no certified means of login.

label.description: How the login screen names the channel.

explanation.description: Explanation under the label on the login screen.

intake.description: The path under $intake under which the fields arrive at the cell; without it: the channel id.

role_label.description: How the frontend names the role of this channel; without it: the role id.

fields.description: The identification fields, in the order of the login screen, by name. Their legal basis is policy (identifies), not deployment.

pattern.description: A regular expression that the whole trimmed value must match; without it: not empty.

message.description: The message for a value that does not comply; without it a generic one.

numeric.description: Digits only: the frontend shows a numeric keyboard.

checksum.description: A weighted check digit test on top of the pattern: the value has exactly one digit per weight, and the sum of each digit times its weight is divisible by the modulus.
